visual_action: The video opens with a clip of a young woman in a red t-shirt sitting in a car and speaking. It then cuts to a montage of a car racing event. Several race car drivers in their racing suits walk down the steps of a large, columned building decorated with American flags, waving to a cheering crowd. There are shots of a pit crew rapidly changing a Firestone tire on a race car. Donald Trump is shown at a podium with the presidential seal, speaking and then waving, with the drivers standing nearby. The montage includes close-ups of a helmet and car branded 'Freedom 250' and a final shot of a pit stop happening on a street in front of a crowd.
